code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, and basophilia. There is also mild hypoproteinemia with relatively high albumin, and low transaminases. These findings may indicate bone marrow suppression or infiltration, possible chronic disease, and impaired oxygenation. Clinical correlation and further diagnostic workup are recommended.
